text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 — Canary deploy deploy/2026-03-15-09 showing elevated errors for /api/v1/checkout. 502s and db deadlocks reported. Paging @oncall-db and @eng-runtime.

oncall-db: I'm on it. pulling canary logs and migration state. any rollback plan?

eng-ryan: i'm looking at the canary hosts. error rate jumps ~09:12 UTC after migration step apply. suspect migration added a NOT NULL column without backfill. stack traces show: 
```
ERROR: column "order_flow_v2" does not exist at character 152
  at Query.parse (/usr/src/app/node_modules/pg/lib/query.js:34:11)
```

sre-tilly: logs show repeated deadlocks on orders table: 
```
FATAL: deadlock detected 
DETAIL: Process 12345 waits for ShareLock on transaction 67890; blocked by process 12346.
```

mohit: that migration was in the canary batch. it's an ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN then an app change reading it. we should flip the feature flag first. canary shouldn't be hitting new reads.

katy: PM: customers on calc path might see checkout failures. we need an ETA for mitigation before escalating to execs.

pm-haris: notify top 5 customers on ASR and add note to status if >15min.

eng-ryan: trying to check migration worker status: 
```
sudo -u deploy prod-sqldb psql -c "SELECT pid, state, query_start, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%ALTER TABLE%' OR query LIKE '%CREATE INDEX%';"
```
found pids 2143 and 2147 stuck in active locking queries.

oncall-db: canceling backend 2147 to break the deadlock: 
```
SELECT pg_cancel_backend(2147);
```

deploy-bot: Canary batch deploy/2026-03-15-09: rollback initiated for canary hosts. Rolling back image to v3.2.1-canary.

eng-platform-liz: suggested immediate workaround: flip feature flag checkout_v2 -> off for canary and production if needed. set kill-switch for the migration-dependent path.

mohit: I agree. killing the feature flag is safer than a full prod rollback for now. feature-flag service call: 
```
curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/redwood/checkout_v2 -d '{"state":"off","actor":"oncall-db"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

support-ana: triage note: started collecting customer error samples to attach to incident. will update status page once we have confirmation post-flip.

eng-ryan: flipped checkout_v2 off on canary and prod: flag change propagated in ~18s. error rate on canary dropped immediately from 35% -> 2%.

oncall-db: good. now we need to address the stuck schema change. options: 1) retry migration with safer DDL (CREATE COLUMN NULL + backfill) then set NOT NULL after backfill, 2) revert migration SQL if possible, 3) keep flag off and schedule maintenance window for migration.

mohit: plan: revert the migration from the deploy (we'll cherry-pick migration revert and deploy to canary), keep flag off, and run a low-priority backfill job followed by promote to NOT NULL in a controlled window.

katy: timeline for revert->canary verify?

eng-ryan: revert deploy to canary done in 8m. canary verified healthy. will start prod revert once SRE thumbs-up.

sre-tilly: I've cleared the remaining locks and validated no active ALTERs. running smoke tests on prod now.

deploy-bot: Prod rollback to v3.2.1 started (rolling restart).

oncall-db: I'll coordinate DB migration plan with mohit: will prepare a safe migration script: 
```
ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN order_flow_v2 JSONB NULL;
-- backfill in batches using primary key ordering to avoid locking
-- after backfill: ALTER TABLE orders ALTER COLUMN order_flow_v2 SET NOT NULL;
```

pm-haris: please capture impact windows and notify customers. 

support-ana: status page updated: "Investigating: intermittent checkout errors. Mitigation in progress (feature flag toggled)."

eng-ryan: prod metrics show error rate back to baseline after rollback and flag off. will monitor for 30m then handoff.

oncall-db: Handoff plan: I'll stay on for 1h to watch migrations and backfills; mohit will own the safe migration write-up and postmortem. If any regression, re-open page.

incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved to degraded/mitigated at 1822350600. Actions: feature flag toggle + prod rollback for canary migration, planned backfill + safe migration. Please file postmortem and include rollout checklist and migration DDL template.

mohit: filing postmortem draft now. will include exact SQL, locking analysis, and recommended deployment gating for future schema-affecting deploys.

katy: thanks everyone. we'll loop in sales for customer comms if support flags higher impact. :thumbsup:
